illustrations.title: Noah's Ark
illustrations.alt: Cutaway drawing of Noah's ark with three decks, a door in the side and a ramp, with side, front, top and cross-section views and the dimensions 300 by 50 by 30 cubits
illustrations.caption: The ark as Genesis 6:14–16 describes it: 300 cubits long, 50 wide and 30 high (about 137 × 23 × 14 m), with lower, middle and upper decks, a door in its side and an opening for light a cubit below the roof. The proportions are the text's; the shape and the details are one reconstruction.
